# ToolNest by Vintayz

> Free calculators and tools that run in the browser: money and tax calculators for freelancers in the US, UK, Canada and Australia, plus PDF, image, text, date and time, developer and everyday tools, resume makers and brain games. No sign-up. Calculations and files stay on the visitor's device.

Tax figures come only from official sources (IRS, HMRC, CRA, ATO, GOV.UK) and each tax tool names its tax year. Results are estimates, not tax, legal or financial advice.

## Freelancer Tools

- [Freelancer Tools](https://vintayz.com/freelance/): all freelancer tools
- [Billable Hours Calculator](https://vintayz.com/freelance/billable-hours-calculator/): Work out how many hours you can realistically bill once admin and sales are counted.
- [Contractor Day Rate Calculator](https://vintayz.com/freelance/contractor-day-rate-calculator/): Work out the day rate you need, allowing for holidays and gaps between contracts.
- [Effective Hourly Rate Calculator](https://vintayz.com/freelance/effective-hourly-rate-calculator/): See what a fixed-price project really paid per hour, once revisions, calls, fees and costs are counted.
- [Emergency Fund Calculator for Freelancers](https://vintayz.com/freelance/emergency-fund-calculator/): Work out how much cash to keep for quiet months, and how long it will take to save.
- [Freelance Hourly Rate Calculator](https://vintayz.com/freelance/freelance-hourly-rate-calculator/): Find the hourly rate you need to hit your take-home income goal after tax, expenses and time off.
- [Freelance Invoice Generator](https://vintayz.com/freelance/invoice-generator/): Create, customize and download professional freelance invoices as PDFs. No sign-up, no watermarks, files stay on your device.
- [Freelance Rate Increase Calculator](https://vintayz.com/freelance/rate-increase-calculator/): See how much work you could lose after raising your rate and still earn the same.
- [Freelance Retainer Calculator](https://vintayz.com/freelance/retainer-calculator/): Turn your hourly rate into a monthly retainer fee, and see what the client's real usage does to your rate.
- [Freelance Tax Set-Aside Calculator](https://vintayz.com/freelance/tax-set-aside-calculator/): How much of each payment to save for tax in the US, UK, Canada or Australia.
- [Hourly to Annual Income Calculator](https://vintayz.com/freelance/hourly-to-annual-income-calculator/): See what an hourly rate adds up to per day, week, month and year.
- [Income Smoothing Calculator](https://vintayz.com/freelance/income-smoothing-calculator/): Turn irregular freelance income into a steady monthly salary with a safety buffer.
- [Late Payment Interest Calculator](https://vintayz.com/freelance/late-payment-interest-calculator/): Calculate interest and fixed compensation on an overdue invoice, including UK statutory interest.
- [Project Pricing Calculator](https://vintayz.com/freelance/project-pricing-calculator/): Turn your hours, costs and a safety buffer into a fixed project quote and deposit.
- [Retirement Savings Calculator](https://vintayz.com/freelance/retirement-savings-calculator/): See what your pension or retirement savings could grow to, and the income they might give you.
- [Timesheet Calculator](https://vintayz.com/freelance/timesheet-calculator/): Add up a week of start and finish times, less breaks, and see what to bill at your hourly rate.
- [Working Days Calculator](https://vintayz.com/freelance/business-days-calculator/): Count working days between two dates, or add working days to a date, skipping US or UK public holidays.

## Business Tools

- [Business Tools](https://vintayz.com/business/): all business tools
- [Break-Even Analysis Calculator](https://vintayz.com/business/break-even-calculator/): Find the exact unit volume and sales revenue needed to cover fixed overheads and start making a profit.
- [Customer Lifetime Value Calculator](https://vintayz.com/business/customer-lifetime-value-calculator/): Work out what a customer is worth in gross profit, compared with what it costs to win them (LTV:CAC).
- [E-Commerce ROAS & Break-Even Calculator](https://vintayz.com/business/roas-calculator/): Calculate Return On Ad Spend, break-even ROAS based on product profit margins, and true campaign net profits.
- [Payment Processing Fee Calculator](https://vintayz.com/business/payment-fee-calculator/): Work out card processing fees, your net payout, and how much to invoice to cover the fee.
- [Profit Margin & Markup Calculator](https://vintayz.com/business/profit-margin-calculator/): Find your gross margin, markup percentage and net profit from your costs and selling price.
- [Quote and Estimate Generator](https://vintayz.com/business/quote-generator/): Make a clear price quote or estimate for a client and download it as a PDF. No sign-up.
- [Sales Tax Calculator](https://vintayz.com/business/sales-tax-calculator/): Add sales tax to a price, or take it out of a total, at the rate you type. For any US state or city.

- [Commission Calculator](https://vintayz.com/career/commission-calculator/): Work out commission on sales at a flat or tiered rate, total pay with base salary, and the sales you need for a goal.
- [Job Offer Comparison Calculator](https://vintayz.com/career/job-offer-comparison-calculator/): Compare two job offers on salary, bonus, benefits, hours and commuting, and see which pays more per hour.
- [Overtime Pay Calculator](https://vintayz.com/career/overtime-calculator/): Work out weekly pay with time-and-a-half and double-time hours.
- [Pay Rise Calculator](https://vintayz.com/career/pay-rise-calculator/): See your raise as a percentage and in money, and whether it beats inflation.
- [Salary to Hourly Calculator](https://vintayz.com/career/salary-to-hourly-calculator/): Convert an annual salary into equivalent hourly, daily, weekly, bi-weekly and overtime rates.
- [UK Holiday Entitlement Calculator](https://vintayz.com/career/uk-holiday-entitlement-calculator/): Your minimum paid holiday in days or hours, including part-time and irregular hours.
- [UK Statutory Redundancy Pay Calculator](https://vintayz.com/career/uk-redundancy-pay-calculator/): Work out the legal minimum redundancy pay from your age, service and weekly pay.
- [UK Take-Home Pay Calculator (2026/27)](https://vintayz.com/career/uk-take-home-pay-calculator/): Your salary after Income Tax, National Insurance, student loan and pension for 2026 to 2027.
- [US Take-Home Pay Calculator (2026)](https://vintayz.com/career/us-take-home-pay-calculator/): Calculate your net W-2 paycheck after 2026 federal income tax, FICA (Social Security & Medicare), and state tax.

- [Freelancer Take-Home Pay Calculator (2026)](https://vintayz.com/us/freelancer-take-home-pay-calculator/): See what you keep after 2026 federal income tax, self-employment tax and state tax.

## United Kingdom

- [United Kingdom](https://vintayz.com/uk/): all united kingdom
- [Business Mileage Allowance Calculator (55p rate)](https://vintayz.com/uk/business-mileage-allowance-calculator/): Claim mileage at HMRC's rates, including the new 55p car rate from April 2026.
- [Dividend Tax Calculator (2026 to 2027)](https://vintayz.com/uk/dividend-tax-calculator/): Work out tax on your dividends for 2026 to 2027, with the dividend allowance and your other income.
- [Payments on Account Calculator](https://vintayz.com/uk/payments-on-account-calculator/): See what Self Assessment payments are due in January and July, and plan for the first-year shock.
- [Self-Employed Tax and NI Calculator (2026/27)](https://vintayz.com/uk/self-employed-tax-calculator/): Work out Income Tax and Class 4 National Insurance on your 2026 to 2027 profits, including Scotland.
- [Sole Trader vs Limited Company Calculator (2026/27)](https://vintayz.com/uk/sole-trader-vs-limited-company-calculator/): Compare take-home pay as a sole trader and as a company director, with 2026 to 2027 dividend rates.
- [VAT Calculator UK (20%)](https://vintayz.com/uk/vat-calculator/): Add 20% or 5% VAT to a price, or take the VAT out of a total, with the £90,000 registration rule.
- [Working From Home Expenses Calculator](https://vintayz.com/uk/working-from-home-expenses-calculator/): Compare HMRC's flat rate with a share of your actual bills and claim the higher.

## PDF Tools

- [PDF Tools](https://vintayz.com/pdf/): all pdf tools
- [Add a Watermark to a PDF](https://vintayz.com/pdf/add-watermark-to-pdf/): Stamp DRAFT, CONFIDENTIAL or your own words across the pages.
- [Add Page Numbers to a PDF](https://vintayz.com/pdf/add-page-numbers-to-pdf/): Number the pages of a PDF, in the corner and style you choose.
- [Add Text to a PDF](https://vintayz.com/pdf/add-text-to-pdf/): Type on any page of a PDF, in the font, size, colour and style you choose.
- [Compress PDF](https://vintayz.com/pdf/compress-pdf/): Make a PDF smaller for email and uploads, while text stays sharp.
- [Delete Pages from a PDF](https://vintayz.com/pdf/delete-pdf-pages/): Remove the pages you don't need and save a new PDF.
- [Edit or Remove PDF Properties](https://vintayz.com/pdf/edit-pdf-metadata/): Change a PDF's title, author and keywords, or remove all its hidden properties before you share it.
- [Extract Pages from a PDF](https://vintayz.com/pdf/extract-pdf-pages/): Pick the pages you need and save just those as a new PDF.
- [JPG to PDF Converter](https://vintayz.com/pdf/jpg-to-pdf/): Turn photos and pictures (JPG, PNG and more) into one PDF.
- [Merge PDF Files](https://vintayz.com/pdf/merge-pdf/): Join several PDFs into one file, in the order you choose.
- [PDF to JPG Converter](https://vintayz.com/pdf/pdf-to-jpg/): Save PDF pages as sharp JPG or PNG pictures.
- [PDF to Text Converter](https://vintayz.com/pdf/pdf-to-text/): Copy the words out of a PDF, or save them as a plain text file.
- [Rearrange PDF Pages](https://vintayz.com/pdf/rearrange-pdf-pages/): Drag pages into a new order, or reverse them, and save the PDF.
- [Rotate PDF Pages](https://vintayz.com/pdf/rotate-pdf/): Turn sideways or upside-down pages the right way up: one page or all of them.
- [Sign a PDF](https://vintayz.com/pdf/sign-pdf/): Draw or type your signature, place it on the page and save the signed PDF.
- [Split PDF](https://vintayz.com/pdf/split-pdf/): Split a PDF into smaller files by page ranges, or one file per page.

- [Developer Tools](https://vintayz.com/dev/): all developer tools
- [Base64 Encode and Decode](https://vintayz.com/dev/base64-encode-decode/): Encode text to Base64 or decode it back, standard or URL-safe, and turn files into data URLs.
- [Color Converter (HEX, RGB, HSL)](https://vintayz.com/dev/color-converter/): Convert colours between HEX, RGB, HSL, HSV and CMYK, with shades and contrast against white and black.
- [Hash Generator (MD5, SHA-256)](https://vintayz.com/dev/hash-generator/): Get the MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 and SHA-512 hash of text or a file, and check a download's checksum.
- [JSON Formatter & Validator](https://vintayz.com/dev/json-formatter/): Beautify, minify, and validate JSON code 100% locally in your browser with instant syntax error highlighting.
- [Password Generator](https://vintayz.com/dev/password-generator/): Make strong random passwords with your choice of length, letters, numbers and symbols. Made on your device.
- [Regex Tester](https://vintayz.com/dev/regex-tester/): Test a JavaScript regular expression: highlighted matches, capture groups and a replace preview.
- [Unix Timestamp Converter](https://vintayz.com/dev/unix-timestamp-converter/): Convert epoch timestamps in seconds or milliseconds to dates in UTC and your time zone, and back.
- [URL Encode and Decode](https://vintayz.com/dev/url-encode-decode/): Percent-encode text for a web address or decode it back, and see an address's parts and query parameters.
- [UUID Generator (v4 and v7)](https://vintayz.com/dev/uuid-generator/): Make random version 4 or time-ordered version 7 UUIDs (GUIDs), and check any UUID.
- [WCAG Color Contrast Checker](https://vintayz.com/dev/color-contrast-checker/): Check text and background color combinations against WCAG 2.1 AA and AAA legal web accessibility standards.

## Brain Games

- [Brain Games](https://vintayz.com/games/): all brain games
- [Four in a Row](https://vintayz.com/games/four-in-a-row/): Drop counters and get four in a line before the computer does, or play a friend on the same device.
- [Klondike Solitaire](https://vintayz.com/games/solitaire/): The classic patience card game. Turn over 1 or 3 cards, with unlimited undo. Tap to move cards.
- [Memory Match](https://vintayz.com/games/memory-match/): Turn over cards two at a time and find every pair in as few moves as you can.
- [Mental Math Test](https://vintayz.com/games/mental-math-test/): Answer as many sums as you can in 60 seconds: adding, taking away, times tables and division.
- [Mine Finder](https://vintayz.com/games/mine-finder/): A minesweeper-style logic puzzle. Use the numbers to find every hidden mine. Your first tap is always safe.
- [Nonogram (Picture Logic Puzzle)](https://vintayz.com/games/nonogram/): Use the number clues to fill the right squares and reveal a hidden pattern. Three sizes.
- [Number Memory Test](https://vintayz.com/games/number-memory-test/): Remember a number, then type it. Each right answer adds a digit. How long a number can you hold?
- [Number Merge Puzzle](https://vintayz.com/games/number-merge-puzzle/): Slide the tiles and join equal numbers to reach 2048. A calm puzzle for a short break.
- [Reaction Time Test](https://vintayz.com/games/reaction-time-test/): Tap the moment the box turns green. Five tries give you an average reaction time in milliseconds.
- [Sequence Memory Test](https://vintayz.com/games/sequence-memory-test/): Watch the squares light up, then tap them in the same order. Each round adds one more.
- [Sliding Puzzle (15 Puzzle)](https://vintayz.com/games/sliding-puzzle/): Slide the numbered tiles back into order. Play the classic 15 puzzle, or a smaller or bigger board.
- [Snake](https://vintayz.com/games/snake/): The classic Snake game: eat the food, grow longer and don't crash. Arrow keys or swipe.
- [Sudoku](https://vintayz.com/games/sudoku/): Free Sudoku puzzles in easy, medium and hard, each with one solution. Notes, hints and mistake checks.
- [Typing Speed Test (WPM)](https://vintayz.com/games/typing-speed-test/): Check your typing speed in words per minute and your accuracy with a 30, 60 or 120 second test.
- [Word Search](https://vintayz.com/games/word-search/): Find the hidden words in a fresh grid every time. Five themes, easy and hard puzzles.
